label: prf:hoefsmit-binding-amplitude
title: Proof of hoefsmit binding amplitude
html:
Proof. Proof of hoefsmit binding amplitude

Proof. The Hoefsmit seminormal matrix for \sigma_2 on V_{(2,1)} has a 2 \times 2 block with entries

  a_\rho = \frac{h}{1 - q^{-2\rho}},
  \qquad
  a_{-\rho} = \frac{h}{1 - q^{2\rho}},
  \qquad
  b = \sqrt{a_\rho \cdot a_{-\rho} + 1},

where \rho = 2 is the axial distance and h = q - q^{-1}. The product of the diagonal entries is

  a_\rho \cdot a_{-\rho}
  = \frac{h^2}{(1 - q^{-4})(1 - q^4)}
  = \frac{h^2}{-(h^2)(h^2 + 4)}
  = -\frac{1}{h^2 + 4}
  = -\frac{1}{[2]_q^2}.

Therefore b^2 = -1/[2]_q^2 + 1 = ([2]_q^2 - 1)/[2]_q^2. Since [2]_q^2 = (q + q^{-1})^2 = h^2 + 4 and [3]_q = q^2 + 1 + q^{-2} = h^2 + 3 = [2]_q^2 - 1:

  b^2 = \frac{[2]_q^2 - 1}{[2]_q^2} = \frac{[3]_q}{[2]_q^2}.
  \qquad\square
